cases.location: Witnessed Entity made of water in my house 2 times as I slept

cases.long_description: As I laid on my couch earlier on this day at approximately 9am , I witnessed an entity made of water and shaped like a human male, walking down my dining room and then running up my stairs. After which around 2pm when I went to take a nap I felt frozen after I put my head on my pillow and looked around, the entity was at the foot of my bed,.standing and staring at me, (at this point my usual episode of seeing colors in my vision like a light oscillating from an unknown source as it washes onto every surface and reveals an unknown series of symbols/glyphs across every surface) just then- the symbols on the wall became extremely clear and articulated themselves into something with more defined edges and lines and was seemingly bolded black in color against my white bedroom wall, I fixated on one particular symbol for a few minutes, then I began to struggle and shake my head. The entity walked away and soon after I could move and I got up. The description of the entity is as follows: Shape of human male, athletic build, muscular arms, a metallic (golden) circlette just above his elbow all the way around.
cases.location: UFO sighting over historic Oklahoma City neighborhood.

cases.long_description: Christi and I were watching TV, and it was around 8 pm last Friday night Jan. 25th, 2025. Christi said she wanted to go get ice cream at [removed name] . Who can pass that up? We stepped out of the house, and she headed for the car while I locked the door. I started moving toward the car and happened to look up and saw what looked like a jelly bean with plasma moving around inside it. I grabbed Christi and said “Look”. She dropped her purse and said, “What the hell is that?” We both started to take video with our phones. I called my next-door neighbor David, who came out, and his jaw dropped. He started calling all the neighbors, and soon we had 15 people out in the street taking pics and shooting video on their phones. David said....”Chris, get one of your drones and send it up.” I had a full battery (35-minute flight time). When I tried to take off, it gave me a "Can't take off due to electromagnetic interference." From time to time, I'll get that message but only around cell or TV towers. I had to recalibrate the drone three times before it allowed me to take off. I flew up to 400 feet and pointed the camera straight up and hit record. It wouldn't record. I tried over and over, so I went to regular camera mode and was able to snap two pics and then I got the "battery low return to home warning" message after only 4 minutes and 18 seconds in flight. When I touched down, the video record function was working again. We watched off and on for almost four hours, and then it was gone.

cases.location: Large saucer-shaped UFO spotted from my driveway (on the top of a mountain). Craft had E to W bearing, then disappeared over the ridge. Ctd

cases.long_description: I was standing in my driveway taking my dog out to answer the call of nature, when I spotted bright white lights in the distance. I live on the top of a mountain for context, and there is a ridge between my mountain, and the surrounding mountains in the distance. I observed the craft initially from a distance of ca. 1/4 mi. away, and it was bearing E to W towards my house. As the craft got closer, I realized that the lights were not a typical aircraft pattern. As it came close towards my house (W of its location) it became obvious that this was not a standard aircraft of any kind I know. The craft came within 100 ft of my house, and was dead silent. It was moving perhaps at 10 mph (too slow for normal aircraft to not fall out of the sky). When the craft was right beside my house you could clearly see that it was disc-shaped (or what one would call a conventional saucer). The dome was clearly visible on top, though it also had a dome of sorts on the underside, also clearly visible. Both the upper and lower domes appeared to be the same size (they craft was symmetrical in shape). The craft had a consistent blinking, white light pattern, that moved counter-clockwise along the edge of the craft. I could not discern the color of the craft, as it's pitch dark at night where I live, but the lights on the craft illuminated it that the shape & size was clearly visible. The craft continued moving E to W until ii disappeared behind the mountains on the other side of me.
Looked like a blinking star. When I zoomed at 5x I could see a triangular shape with flashing lights.

cases.location: Star-like ufo hovers in So. Cal for 3 hrs then disappears!

cases.long_description: I was watching a movie then had a sudden urge to look out of my back door. I saw through the glass a large white star. It was unusually bright and big, and low on the horizon. I couldn't tell if it was out in space, or over the little valley behind our house. It was stationary in its position for several minutes. Then it tilted diagonally. Then I saw a private drone circling around it. This proved that the "star" was not in space and was local! Then several minutes after that I saw a military drone fly into the area, which didn't stay very long. Maybe it was hovering out of my line of sight. I then asked the star if it could show me a sign that it wasn't man-made. A few minutes later, it tilted diagonally again, then rotated showing me a larger bulging light on one of its sides, then it just disappeared! Then after a few seconds it just reappeared! I ran upstairs and made my husband get up and watch it with me from our bedroom window. He saw it too. I went back downstairs to watch outside again. It disappeared and reappeared 2 more times , then vanished for the last time. BUT then 2 smaller "stars" suddenly appeared , one at a time, and positioned themselves parallel to the streetlights on the ridge on the other side of our valley. They looked almost exactly like the streetlights except they were slightly more brilliant and had no poles connecting them to the ground! I could tell they were camouflaging! Then after about 3-4 minutes, they dissapeared one at a time. My observation lasted about 45 to 50 minutes. The next day I asked my next door neighbor if he saw anything. He said that he and his daughter saw that bright light just b4 sunset, but he thought it was a reflection of some sort, and went about his business. But since they saw it before sundown, I roughly calculate that it hovered about 3 hours, because my experience ended around just b4 9 pm. I was in awe, exhilarated, I giggled about the streetlight thing, and I'll never be the same! NOTE: My photo just shows a plain white circle and none of the Ray's that were shooting out of it. If you enlarge the pic, you can see a little red dot to the left- that is the private drone. Ignore our backyard tiki torch.

cases.location: Bright white orb in the sky, moved west then straight up and ejected a much smaller, more dim orb that seemed to drop form the orb then move west

cases.long_description: I was walking my dog at my apartment complex and noticed a very bright orb high in the sky. This orb was brighter and much larger than any stars or planes in the sky. The sky was completely clear, no cloud cover. The orb was pulsating and not perfectly circular. I witnessed the orb move westward across the sky and then straight up. It then stopped and a much smaller, dim orb came from the bottom of the large bright orb. It descended then moved west across the sky climbing in altitude as it went. The smaller orb was much smaller and dimmer than anything in the sky to the point it was hard to track and lost sight of it within a minute and a half or so. The large orb stayed stationary after this while I was in the fenced dog park in the middle of our complex for about 20 minutes. I kept watching the orb and did not notice any major movements for the remainder of the sighting. I went back outside to the dog park area around 11:30 p.m. the same evening and the orb was completely gone, and in that patch of the sky there were no visible stars it was just black.
